title: watch: is_valid_last_event_id restricts to kithd format without documenting why
description: is_valid_last_event_id accepts only empty string or 's-N' pattern. The SSE spec accepts any string without NULL/CR/LF. This works today because kithd emits 's-N' IDs, but the restriction is not documented as intentional coupling. A contributor adding a different ID format to kithd would find watch.rs silently discarding the IDs (the invalid ID is not sent as Last-Event-ID) without understanding why. Add a comment explaining the intentional tie to kithd's state-counter format.
